title: The Economy Is Booming. Or Is It?

sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是安德鲁·罗斯-索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》旗下的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的DealBook峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的领导人，包括J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on
sentences.zh: 我们将在11月18日通过nytimes.com网站直播部分采访内容，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: November 18th.
If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Bavaro.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴瓦罗。

sentences.en: This is Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: economy is in the middle of a historic boom.
sentences.zh: 经济正处于历史性的繁荣之中。

sentences.en: So why is the government now deploying an economic weapon it last used during the financial crisis?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么政府现在要动用一种上次在金融危机期间才使用过的经济武器呢？

sentences.en: Plus, last night's Democratic debate.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有昨晚的民主党辩论。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, August 1St.
sentences.zh: 今天是8月1日，星期四。

sentences.en: Come on in here.
sentences.zh: 快进来。

sentences.en: Hey.
sentences.zh: 嘿。

sentences.en: Is C-SPAN where it's at for Federal Reserve announcements?
sentences.zh: C-SPAN是获取美联储公告的最佳渠道吗？

sentences.en: I mean, it'll be on every channel, man.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，伙计，每个频道都会播的。

sentences.en: On Wednesday afternoon, economics reporter Ben Castleman stopped by the studio.
sentences.zh: 周三下午，经济记者本·卡斯尔曼来到了演播室。

sentences.en: C-SPAN will have the whole thing.
sentences.zh: C-SPAN会全程直播。

sentences.en: I checked online.
sentences.zh: 我在网上查过了。

sentences.en: We'll keep it on C-SPAN.
sentences.zh: 我们就锁定C-SPAN吧。

sentences.en: So Ben, give us a little bit of context about what we're waiting for.
sentences.zh: 那么本，给我们介绍一下我们正在等待的内容背景吧。

sentences.en: So the Fed announced 28 minutes ago that it is cutting interest rates for the first time since the financial crisis.
sentences.zh: 美联储在28分钟前宣布，自金融危机以来首次下调利率。

sentences.en: They cut a quarter percentage point, which sounds very, very small.
sentences.zh: 他们下调了四分之一个百分点，听起来非常、非常小。

sentences.en: Truly.
sentences.zh: 确实。

sentences.en: But makes a very big difference.
sentences.zh: 但影响却非常大。

sentences.en: There had been some talk they might go crazy and cut a half percentage point, but they didn't go that crazy.
sentences.zh: 之前曾有传言说他们可能会激进地降息半个百分点，但他们没那么疯狂。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: We are now waiting to hear Jay Powell, the Fed chair, come out and talk to us about why they did that and what that means.
sentences.zh: 我们现在正等着听美联储主席杰伊·鲍威尔出来向我们解释他们为什么要这样做，以及这意味着什么。

sentences.en: And what everybody's going to be listening for is any hint of what happens next.
sentences.zh: 大家都在关注的是，他是否会透露任何关于下一步行动的暗示。

sentences.en: And was there a lot of debate around that decision?
sentences.zh: 关于这个决定，内部有很多争论吗？

sentences.en: There has been a lot of debate in the months leading up to this because on the surface, the economy right now is pretty good, right?
sentences.zh: 在过去几个月里，确实有很多争论，因为从表面上看，现在的经济状况相当不错，对吧？

sentences.en: The unemployment rate is close to a five-decade low.
sentences.zh: 失业率接近五十年来的最低点。

sentences.en: This is now the longest economic expansion in American history.
sentences.zh: 这是美国历史上最长的经济扩张期。

sentences.en: We have been adding jobs for eight or nine years straight now.
sentences.zh: 我们已经连续八九年一直在增加就业岗位了。

sentences.en: Wages are rising.
sentences.zh: 工资在上涨。

sentences.en: I mean, things are pretty good.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，一切都相当不错。

sentences.en: And normally the Fed cuts rates when things are bad or when it's worried things are getting bad.
sentences.zh: 通常情况下，美联储只会在经济糟糕或担心经济变糟时才会降息。

sentences.en: And so there were a lot of people who looked at that and said, why would the Fed be taking action now when the economy is in pretty good shape?
sentences.zh: 所以很多人看到这一点会问，为什么经济状况良好时美联储要采取行动？

sentences.en: In fact, often in a situation like this, you might expect the Fed to be raising interest rates to try to keep the economy from overheating.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在这种情况下，你通常会预期美联储会加息，以防止经济过热。

sentences.en: But they're looking out there and they're seeing a lot of things to be worried about in the future.
sentences.zh: 但他们放眼望去，看到了未来有很多令人担忧的事情。

sentences.en: And they're basically trying to take out an insurance policy here and make sure that we don't go over the edge.
sentences.zh: 他们基本上是在这里购买一份保险，以确保我们不会跌落悬崖。

sentences.en: So there are real differences of opinion, it sounds like, about whether the federal government should intervene in this moment.
sentences.zh: 听起来对于联邦政府此时是否应该干预，确实存在不同的意见。

sentences.en: And we're waiting to hear what the Fed chief, Jerome Powell, says about why they did it.
sentences.zh: 我们正在等待美联储主席杰罗姆·鲍威尔解释他们为何这样做。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Federal Reserve announcing today it's cutting interest rates by a quarter of a percent.
sentences.zh: 美联储今天宣布降息四分之一个百分点。

sentences.en: Okay, we're going to listen.
sentences.zh: 好了，我们来听听。

sentences.en: Holding a news conference live on C-SPAN.
sentences.zh: 正在C-SPAN上进行现场新闻发布会。

sentences.en: Can you guys turn this up?
sentences.zh: 你们能把声音调大点吗？

sentences.en: And I'll discuss the thinking behind today's interest rate reduction and then turn to the path forward.
sentences.zh: 我将讨论今天降息背后的思考，然后转向未来的路径。

sentences.en: As the year began, both the economy and monetary policy were in a good place.
sentences.zh: 年初时，经济和货币政策都处于良好的状态。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate was below four percent and inflation had been running near our two percent objective.
sentences.zh: 失业率低于4%，通胀率也一直保持在我们2%的目标附近。

sentences.en: So he's making the it's been good case.
sentences.zh: 所以他是在陈述“情况一直很好”的观点。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Over the first half of the year, the economy grew at a healthy pace and job gains pushed unemployment to near a half century low.
sentences.zh: 上半年，经济以健康的步伐增长，就业增长将失业率推至近半个世纪以来的最低点。

sentences.en: So we're waiting for a bud.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在等一个“但是”。

sentences.en: We're waiting for a bud.
sentences.zh: 我们在等一个“但是”。

sentences.en: It will come.
sentences.zh: 它会来的。

sentences.en: People who live and work in low and middle income communities tell us that many who have struggled
sentences.zh: 在低收入和中等收入社区生活和工作的人们告诉我们，许多曾经努力

sentences.en: to find work are now getting opportunities to add new and better chapters to their lives.
sentences.zh: 寻找工作的人现在正获得机会，为他们的生活增添新的、更好的篇章。

sentences.en: What we're listening for is how big is the bud?
sentences.zh: 我们想听的是，这个“但是”有多大？

sentences.en: The median committee participants assessments of the neutral rate of interest in the longer run normal rate of unemployment have also declined this year.
sentences.zh: 委员会成员对长期中性利率和正常失业率的评估中值今年也有所下降。

sentences.en: I warned you the fireworks were muted, right?
sentences.zh: 我警告过你，烟花表演会很平淡，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: These changes in the anticipated path of interest rates have eased financial conditions and have supported the economy.
sentences.zh: 这些对利率预期路径的调整缓解了金融状况，并支撑了经济。

sentences.en: Are we sure that we want this to be a full episode of The Daily?
sentences.zh: 我们确定要把这做成《每日新闻》的完整一集吗？

sentences.en: That only you can decide.
sentences.zh: 这只有你能决定。

sentences.en: But manufacturing output has declined for two consecutive quarters.
sentences.zh: 但制造业产出已连续两个季度下降。

sentences.en: But business fixed investment fell in the second quarter.
sentences.zh: 而且企业固定资产投资在第二季度出现了下滑。

sentences.en: This is the downside.
sentences.zh: 这就是负面因素。

sentences.en: That's the downside.
sentences.zh: 那是负面因素。

sentences.en: Foreign growth has disappointed, particularly in manufacturing and notably in the euro area and China.
sentences.zh: 海外增长令人失望，特别是在制造业方面，尤其是在欧元区和中国。

sentences.en: So what case is he making here?
sentences.zh: 那么他在这里提出了什么论点？

sentences.en: He's making the case that there is a lot of uncertainty right now and that there are signs that the global economy is slowing and that that might be starting to affect the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他提出的论点是，目前存在很大的不确定性，有迹象表明全球经济正在放缓，这可能也开始影响到美国。

sentences.en: as well.
sentences.zh: 也是如此。

sentences.en: After simmering early in the year, trade policy tensions nearly boiled over in May and June.
sentences.zh: 贸易政策紧张局势在年初酝酿后，于5月和6月几乎爆发。

sentences.en: And that that is making businesses nervous about what the future looks like.
sentences.zh: 这让企业对未来感到担忧。

sentences.en: Looking through this variability, our business contacts tell us that the ongoing uncertainty is making some companies more cautious about their capital spending.
sentences.zh: 透过这种波动性，我们的商业联系人告诉我们，持续的不确定性正使一些公司在资本支出方面变得更加谨慎。

sentences.en: And that's maybe a sign that the economy is not as strong as some of these other measures might suggeSt.
sentences.zh: 这也许是一个迹象，表明经济并不像其他一些指标所暗示的那样强劲。

sentences.en: We're mindful that inflation's return to 2 percent may be further delayed and that continued
sentences.zh: 我们注意到，通胀率回到2%的目标可能会进一步推迟，而且持续

sentences.en: below-target inflation could lead to a worrisome and difficult-to-reverse downward slide in longer-term expectations.
sentences.zh: 低于目标的通胀可能会导致长期预期出现令人担忧且难以逆转的下滑。

sentences.en: It's a sense that the Fed needs to insure against things getting worse.
sentences.zh: 这是一种美联储需要为情况恶化提供保障的感觉。

sentences.en: It's not just that things are weaker overseas as they could get weaker still.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是海外情况变弱，它们还可能变得更弱。

sentences.en: It's not just that there's a trade war.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为有贸易战。

sentences.en: It's that the trade war could get worse.
sentences.zh: 而是贸易战可能会进一步恶化。

sentences.en: And the Fed would rather give the economy sort of a little bit of a kick now so that it has
sentences.zh: 美联储宁愿现在给经济一点推动力，这样它就有

sentences.en: some momentum in case things get worse rather than waiting for things to actually slow down and needing to give it a bigger shove to get things moving.
sentences.zh: 一些动力，以防情况恶化，而不是等到情况真正放缓时，才需要给它更大的推力来让它运转起来。

sentences.en: It will continue to monitor the implications of incoming information for the economic outlook
sentences.zh: 我们将继续监测即将到来的信息对经济前景的影响，

sentences.en: and will act as appropriate to sustain the expansion with a strong labor market and inflation near its symmetric 2 percent objective.
sentences.zh: 并将采取适当行动，以强劲的劳动力市场和接近其对称的2%目标的通胀率来维持经济扩张。

sentences.en: I feel like you guys have your own vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 我觉得你们有自己的一套词汇。

sentences.en: There is absolutely a Fed vocabulary.
sentences.zh: 确实有一套美联储词汇。

sentences.en: It's subtle.
sentences.zh: 很微妙。

sentences.en: Thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: So is that all crystal clear to you?
sentences.zh: 那么，这对你来说完全清楚了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, crystal clear like an opaque window.
sentences.zh: 是的，像不透明的窗户一样“完全清楚”。

sentences.en: Can we start with a really basic question?
sentences.zh: 我们可以从一个非常基本的问题开始吗？

sentences.en: What is the role of the Fed?
sentences.zh: 美联储的角色是什么？

sentences.en: And in particular, what's the role of its leader in a moment like this?
sentences.zh: 特别是，在这样的时刻，其领导人的角色是什么？

sentences.en: The Fed is our primary tool for trying to keep the economy in a good place.
sentences.zh: 美联储是我们试图保持经济良好状态的主要工具。

sentences.en: It's as simple as that.
sentences.zh: 就这么简单。

sentences.en: They have two missions.
sentences.zh: 他们有两个使命。

sentences.en: They're meant to try to maintain maximum employment, to basically keep unemployment as low as possible, and price stability, to try to avoid letting inflation get out of control.
sentences.zh: 他们旨在努力维持充分就业，基本上是让失业率尽可能低，以及价格稳定，试图避免通胀失控。

sentences.en: And their main tool for dealing with that is interest rates.
sentences.zh: 他们处理这些问题的主要工具是利率。

sentences.en: And tell me how that works.
sentences.zh: 告诉我这是怎么运作的。

sentences.en: So the Fed basically sets the interest rates that are then used to decide everything else through the economy.
sentences.zh: 美联储基本上设定了利率，然后这些利率被用来决定经济中的一切。

sentences.en: What your mortgage rate is going to be, what companies that want to borrow money in order to invest or to hire more workers, what they're going to pay.
sentences.zh: 你的抵押贷款利率是多少，想要借钱投资或雇佣更多工人的公司需要支付多少利息。

sentences.en: When interest rates are low, it's cheap to borrow.
sentences.zh: 当利率很低时，借钱很便宜。

sentences.en: And so that encourages people to borrow more and to spend more, and that helps the economy go faster.
sentences.zh: 这鼓励人们借更多的钱，花更多的钱，从而帮助经济更快地发展。

sentences.en: The risk is if it goes too fast, then we start to see inflation.
sentences.zh: 风险在于，如果发展太快，我们就会开始看到通胀。

sentences.en: Prices go up, and they start going up so fast that that can become a really big problem in the economy, right?
sentences.zh: 价格上涨，而且上涨速度太快，这可能会成为经济中一个非常大的问题，对吧？

sentences.en: We saw this in this country in the 70s.
sentences.zh: 我们在70年代的美国就看到了这一点。

sentences.en: The Fed doesn't want to let that happen.
sentences.zh: 美联储不想让这种情况发生。

sentences.en: So if the economy starts to go too fast, they're going to try to tap the brakes and slow it down.
sentences.zh: 所以如果经济开始过热，他们会试图踩刹车，让它慢下来。

sentences.en: By raising the interest rate, which raises the cost of borrowing, which raises the price of things like your mortgage or your credit card bill.
sentences.zh: 通过提高利率，这增加了借贷成本，从而提高了抵押贷款或信用卡账单等的价格。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Or for a business, they'll be less likely to borrow money, so they'll be less likely to keep investing.
sentences.zh: 或者对于企业来说，他们借钱的可能性会降低，因此他们继续投资的可能性也会降低。

sentences.en: They'll be less likely to hire more workers, and it'll slow things down.
sentences.zh: 他们雇佣更多工人的可能性会降低，这会让经济慢下来。

sentences.en: Okay, so it's been how long since we did this last?
sentences.zh: 好的，那么我们上次这样做已经过去多久了？

sentences.en: Since the middle of the recession, more than a decade ago.
sentences.zh: 自十多年前经济衰退中期以来。

sentences.en: Okay, so help us understand how we got to this moment today, where the Federal Reserve decided to lower interest rates for the first time since then.
sentences.zh: 好的，那么请帮我们理解我们是如何走到今天这一步的，美联储决定自那时以来首次下调利率。

sentences.en: So in the middle of the financial crisis, the Fed had to act aggressively to try to basically keep the economy from pitching into the Great Depression again.
sentences.zh: 在金融危机期间，美联储不得不采取激进行动，试图基本上防止经济再次陷入大萧条。

sentences.en: They cut interest rates as far as they could, all the way to zero.
sentences.zh: 他们尽可能地大幅降息，一直降到了零。

sentences.en: To zero.
sentences.zh: 降到零。

sentences.en: To zero.
sentences.zh: 降到零。

sentences.en: Which means what exactly?
sentences.zh: 这到底意味着什么？

sentences.en: It means, essentially, for the safest borrowers, they could borrow money for practically nothing.
sentences.zh: 这意味着，对于最安全的借款人来说，他们几乎可以免费借钱。

sentences.en: There was essentially...
sentences.zh: 基本上存在……

sentences.en: Cost-free borrowing of money.
sentences.zh: 零成本借钱。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, no actual human being could borrow money for literally zero, but it was as cheap as money could be.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，没有真正的人类可以字面上以零利率借钱，但它已经是钱能达到的最便宜的价格了。

sentences.en: If you wanted to borrow money, you could have it.
sentences.zh: 如果你想借钱，你就能借到。

sentences.en: And what's the rationale for doing that?
sentences.zh: 那么这样做的基本原理是什么？

sentences.en: That the economy was in really bad shape, and they needed to find some way to encourage businesses to invest, consumers to spend, to try to get things moving again.
sentences.zh: 当时经济状况非常糟糕，他们需要找到某种方法来鼓励企业投资、消费者消费，试图让经济重新运转起来。

sentences.en: And they went to lengths that the Fed has never gone to before to try to make that happen.
sentences.zh: 他们采取了美联储从未尝试过的手段来试图实现这一目标。

sentences.en: And it worked in the sense that the economy began to get better.
sentences.zh: 从经济开始好转的意义上来说，它奏效了。

sentences.en: The unemployment rate got as high as 10%.
sentences.zh: 失业率曾高达10%。

sentences.en: It began to fall.
sentences.zh: 它开始下降。

sentences.en: Jobs had been getting cut at the rate of hundreds of thousands a month.
sentences.zh: 就业岗位曾以每月数十万的速度被削减。

sentences.en: They began to increase.
sentences.zh: 它们开始增加。

sentences.en: Incomes gradually began to go back up, right?
sentences.zh: 收入逐渐开始回升，对吧？

sentences.en: Corporate profits rebounded.
sentences.zh: 企业利润反弹。

sentences.en: The stock market rebounded.
sentences.zh: 股市反弹。

sentences.en: And what's happening to that interest rate as that recovery begins?
sentences.zh: 那么在复苏开始时，利率会发生什么变化呢？

sentences.en: For most of that period, nothing at all.
sentences.zh: 在那段时期的大部分时间里，什么都没发生。

sentences.en: It stayed at zero for years.
sentences.zh: 利率维持在零水平长达数年之久。

sentences.en: Even though the economy was starting to see some signs of improvement, it wasn't enough that the Fed felt that they could start to raise interest rates.
sentences.zh: 尽管经济开始出现一些好转迹象，但美联储认为这还不足以让他们开始加息。

sentences.en: And when does that start to change?
sentences.zh: 那么这种情况什么时候开始改变呢？

sentences.en: So finally, at the end of 2015.
sentences.zh: 最终，在2015年底。

sentences.en: Good afternoon.
sentences.zh: 下午好。

sentences.en: The Fed raises rates.
sentences.zh: 美联储加息了。

sentences.en: Earlier today, the Federal Open Market Committee decided to raise the target range for the federal funds rate by one-quarter percentage point.
sentences.zh: 今天早些时候，联邦公开市场委员会决定将联邦基金利率的目标区间上调四分之一个百分点。

sentences.en: A quarter point.
sentences.zh: 四分之一个百分点。

sentences.en: Bringing it to one-quarter to one-half percent.
sentences.zh: 使其达到0.25%到0.5%之间。

sentences.en: The smallest possible increase they could make.
sentences.zh: 这是他们能做出的最小幅度的上调。

sentences.en: And that's a kind of vote of confidence in the health of the economy.
sentences.zh: 这算是对经济健康状况投下的一张信任票。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The economy was finally starting to return to normal.
sentences.zh: 经济终于开始恢复正常了。

sentences.en: As I will explain, the process of normalizing interest rates is likely to proceed gradually.
sentences.zh: 正如我将要解释的那样，利率正常化的过程可能会循序渐进地进行。

sentences.en: And they actually talked about it.
sentences.zh: 他们确实讨论过这个问题。

sentences.en: They talked about it that way as normalization.
sentences.zh: 他们将其称为“正常化”。

sentences.en: That they were trying to get back to a period where interest rates were no longer near zero.
sentences.zh: 他们试图回到利率不再接近于零的时期。

sentences.en: They were the way we think about interest rates, right?
sentences.zh: 这就是我们看待利率的方式，对吧？

sentences.en: It actually costs money to borrow again.
sentences.zh: 借钱再次有了成本。

sentences.en: This action marks the end of an extraordinary seven-year period during which the federal funds
sentences.zh: 这一举措标志着一个非凡的七年时期的结束，在此期间，联邦基金

sentences.en: rate was held near zero to support the recovery of the economy from the worst financial crisis and recession since the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 利率一直保持在接近零的水平，以支持经济从大萧条以来最严重的金融危机和衰退中复苏。

sentences.en: So they raise interest rates by a quarter point.
sentences.zh: 所以他们加息了四分之一个百分点。

sentences.en: And then they do it again.
sentences.zh: 然后他们又加了一次。

sentences.en: And they do it again.
sentences.zh: 接着又加了一次。

sentences.en: And they do it again.
sentences.zh: 又加了一次。

sentences.en: They eventually do it nine times over that period from 2015 until just last year.
sentences.zh: 从2015年到去年，他们最终在那段时间里加息了九次。

sentences.en: Eventually, rates were basically at two and a quarter to two and a half points.
sentences.zh: 最终，利率基本达到了2.25%到2.5%之间。

sentences.en: Still very, very low by historic standards, but more normal compared to where they had been in the middle of the recession.
sentences.zh: 按历史标准来看仍然非常非常低，但与衰退期间的水平相比，已经更正常了。

sentences.en: And at the end of all these gradual interest rate increases, where does the economy stand?
sentences.zh: 在经历了所有这些渐进式加息之后，现在的经济状况如何？

sentences.en: So the economy right now is good.
sentences.zh: 目前的经济状况良好。

sentences.en: There are a lot of caveats.
sentences.zh: 当然还有很多需要注意的地方。

sentences.en: We can go through a lot of those caveats.
sentences.zh: 我们可以详细讨论其中的许多注意事项。

sentences.en: But on a basic level, the economy right now is in good shape.
sentences.zh: 但从基本层面来看，目前的经济状况不错。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《纽约时报》才能阅读所有的报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能让你免费试用一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息，去探索《纽约时报》呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间越过付费墙，看看时报订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载时报应用程序，获取30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: Ben, I think we should go through those caveats for just a moment.
sentences.zh: 本，我觉得我们应该花点时间讨论一下那些注意事项。

sentences.en: This has felt a bit like a funny moment in the economy because many Americans see that the economy is doing well, but there's also a pretty pervasive sense of insecurity.
sentences.zh: 这在经济上感觉是一个有趣的时刻，因为许多美国人看到经济表现良好，但同时也存在一种相当普遍的不安全感。

sentences.en: Does that feel right?
sentences.zh: 这种感觉对吗？

sentences.en: I think that's right.
sentences.zh: 我认为是对的。

sentences.en: I think that it helps to step back and think about what we even mean when we say, how is the economy doing?
sentences.zh: 我认为退一步思考我们所说的“经济表现如何”到底是什么意思，会有所帮助。

sentences.en: So one way to think about that is, how is the economy doing right now?
sentences.zh: 所以，思考这个问题的一种方式是：现在的经济表现如何？

sentences.en: Do people have jobs?
sentences.zh: 人们有工作吗？

sentences.en: Do they have incomes that are sufficient to pay for their needs and for their desires?
sentences.zh: 他们的收入是否足以支付他们的需求和欲望？

sentences.en: And in that sense, things right now are looking really good.
sentences.zh: 从这个意义上说，目前的情况看起来确实不错。

sentences.en: But there are concerns about where things are in sort of a larger context.
sentences.zh: 但人们对大环境下的现状仍有担忧。

sentences.en: And I think that's some of what you're picking up on, which is, okay, I have a job, but is it enough to set aside money for retirement?
sentences.zh: 我认为你所察觉到的正是这一点，即：好吧，我有工作，但这足够为退休存钱吗？

sentences.en: I have a job, but is it enough to pay off my student loans?
sentences.zh: 我有工作，但这足够偿还我的学生贷款吗？

sentences.en: Am I ever going to be able to buy a house?
sentences.zh: 我还能买得起房子吗？

sentences.en: Am I confident that my job is not going to be lost to a robot or an algorithm or to a worker overseas?
sentences.zh: 我是否确信我的工作不会被机器人、算法或海外工人取代？

sentences.en: And that, I think, ends up getting to this sort of larger question of whether this economy is working for the average person.
sentences.zh: 我认为，这最终归结为一个更大的问题，即这种经济是否在为普通人服务。

sentences.en: If you own stocks, you're doing great.
sentences.zh: 如果你拥有股票，你过得很好。

sentences.en: If you were just relying on wage income, not so much.
sentences.zh: 如果你只是依靠工资收入，那就没那么好了。

sentences.en: And if you are further down to the bottom of the ladder, if you have less education, if you are in a part of the country where there aren't a lot of good jobs, if you are black
sentences.zh: 如果你处于社会阶梯的底层，受教育程度较低，或者身处一个没有多少好工作的地区，如果你是黑人

sentences.en: or brown or an immigrant, you may very well be working a job that's part-time, that may not offer health insurance, where you may be a gig worker who's not an employee at all.
sentences.zh: 或棕色人种，或者是移民，你很可能从事的是兼职工作，可能没有医疗保险，甚至可能是一个根本没有雇主身份的零工。

sentences.en: For those people, this economy doesn't feel like it's working.
sentences.zh: 对这些人来说，这种经济感觉并不奏效。

sentences.en: And so they can look at this and say, I hear the unemployment rate is low, and I believe that.
sentences.zh: 所以他们看着这一切会说，我听说失业率很低，我相信这一点。

sentences.en: I can get a job, but it doesn't feel like I can afford that sort of middle-class life that I might have anticipated.
sentences.zh: 我能找到工作，但感觉我负担不起我所预期的那种中产阶级生活。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So with that in mind, what are we to make of this decision by the Fed just 35 minutes ago to cut the interest rates?
sentences.zh: 考虑到这一点，我们该如何解读美联储在35分钟前做出的降息决定？

sentences.en: So the conventional wisdom has been that all that stuff I was just saying about the long run and inequality and all of those concerns, the conventional wisdom has been none of that
sentences.zh: 传统的观点一直认为，我刚才说的关于长期发展、不平等以及所有那些担忧，传统观点认为这些都不是

sentences.en: is something the Fed should even be thinking about.
sentences.zh: 美联储应该考虑的事情。

sentences.en: They are thinking about how is the economy doing today and where is it going over the next couple of years?
sentences.zh: 他们考虑的是经济现在的表现如何，以及未来几年将走向何方？

sentences.en: But I think there was a really interesting moment in the press conference.
sentences.zh: 但我认为新闻发布会上有一个非常有趣的时刻。

sentences.en: Powell made a point where he said earlier this year when things were going so well, we were seeing wage growth, especially at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔强调说，今年早些时候，当经济形势大好时，我们看到了工资增长，尤其是在底层群体中。

sentences.en: And there's been a bit of a shift in the way that the Fed has been thinking over the last several years, where there's a recognition that in periods of a really strong economy,
sentences.zh: 美联储过去几年的思维方式发生了一些转变，人们认识到，在经济非常强劲的时期，

sentences.en: the benefits often flow disproportionately to people at the bottom, to the exact same people that we've been saying have been left behind in a lot of the recovery.
sentences.zh: 收益往往不成比例地流向底层群体，正是那些我们一直说在复苏中被遗忘的人。

sentences.en: It helps people at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 这有助于底层群体。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's a pretty simple reason for that.
sentences.zh: 这背后有一个非常简单的原因。

sentences.en: When the economy is really strong, and especially when the unemployment rate is really low, it gives bargaining power to people who don't normally have it.
sentences.zh: 当经济非常强劲，尤其是失业率非常低时，它赋予了通常没有议价能力的人以议价能力。

sentences.en: So we've written stories about people with criminal records getting jobs, people with disabilities getting jobs, people who've been out of the workforce for a really long time
sentences.zh: 我们写过关于有犯罪记录的人找到工作、残疾人找到工作、长期脱离劳动力市场的人

sentences.en: getting jobs or being able to demand better pay, companies offering training.
sentences.zh: 找到工作或能够要求更高工资的故事，企业也在提供培训。

sentences.en: We saw just the other day Amazon announced a big training program because they're saying, we can't find the people that we really want to hire, so we'll hire other people and we'll
sentences.zh: 我们前几天刚看到亚马逊宣布了一项大型培训计划，因为他们说，我们找不到我们真正想雇佣的人，所以我们会雇佣其他人，然后我们会

sentences.en: train them up.
sentences.zh: 培训他们。

sentences.en: We'll give them skills and we'll pay them more as a result.
sentences.zh: 我们会赋予他们技能，结果我们会给他们更高的报酬。

sentences.en: So when unemployment is low and the economy is doing really well, the most vulnerable members of our economy suddenly have more leverage and greater opportunity.
sentences.zh: 因此，当失业率低且经济表现非常好时，我们经济中最脆弱的成员突然拥有了更多的筹码和更大的机会。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: And what Powell was saying there is this is finally happening.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔所说的是，这种情况终于发生了。

sentences.en: Why would we let it end?
sentences.zh: 我们为什么要让它结束呢？

sentences.en: We should do everything we can to try to keep this going while we can, because it's finally benefiting the people who didn't benefit for such a long time.
sentences.zh: 我们应该尽一切努力让这种势头持续下去，因为它终于惠及了那些长期以来没有受益的人。

sentences.en: And because we're in that moment right now, that kind of moment where the unemployment rate is really low and it's starting to help people at the bottom.
sentences.zh: 而且因为我们现在正处于那个时刻，那种失业率非常低且开始帮助底层群体的时刻。

sentences.en: Keeping things going for longer, at least in theory, will help those people at the bottom more.
sentences.zh: 从理论上讲，让这种势头持续更长时间，将更多地帮助那些底层群体。

sentences.en: And maybe some of that even lasts when the economy eventually does slow.
sentences.zh: 也许当经济最终放缓时，其中一些好处甚至会持续存在。

sentences.en: Some of those benefits will stick around.
sentences.zh: 这些好处中的一部分会留存下来。

sentences.en: So even though the Federal Reserve doesn't see its job as kind of socioeconomic engineering,
sentences.zh: 所以，尽管美联储并不认为自己的工作是某种社会经济工程，

sentences.en: fixing the income inequality in this country, you're saying the interest rate cut is in a way designed to try to fix that.
sentences.zh: 即解决这个国家的收入不平等问题，但你是说降息在某种程度上是为了尝试解决这个问题。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The Fed has faced a lot of criticism for a long time for thinking mostly about people at the top, for helping Wall Street, for helping finance, and not thinking about the way that
sentences.zh: 美联储长期以来一直面临很多批评，因为他们主要考虑的是顶层群体，帮助华尔街，帮助金融业，而不考虑其政策

sentences.en: its policies flow through the whole economy.
sentences.zh: 如何影响整个经济。

sentences.en: And there have been groups that have been pushing, saying, hey, don't get overstressed about inflation.
sentences.zh: 有一些团体一直在推动，说，嘿，不要对通货膨胀过度紧张。

sentences.en: Don't get too worried about what's happening on Wall Street.
sentences.zh: 不要太担心华尔街发生了什么。

sentences.en: Think about how your policies affect people who are often left out of the economy.
sentences.zh: 想想你的政策如何影响那些经常被排除在经济之外的人。

sentences.en: And the way to help them is to let the economy get hot, hotter maybe than the Fed in the past would have been comfortable.
sentences.zh: 帮助他们的方法是让经济热起来，也许比美联储过去所能接受的程度更热。

sentences.en: And Powell, to some extent, is saying, I'm buying into that, at least to some degree.
sentences.zh: 鲍威尔在某种程度上是在说，我接受这一点，至少在某种程度上是这样。

sentences.en: And it may not be his overriding goal, but it's baked in to how the Federal Reserve behaved on Wednesday.
sentences.zh: 这可能不是他的首要目标，但这已经融入了美联储周三的行为方式中。

sentences.en: That's exactly right.
sentences.zh: 完全正确。

sentences.en: Ben, everything you've just said makes me think that the economy is doing pretty well.
sentences.zh: 本，你刚才所说的一切让我觉得经济表现相当不错。

sentences.en: The Federal Reserve wants to keep it that way, but that it sees signs of storm clouds.
sentences.zh: 美联储希望保持这种状态，但它看到了乌云密布的迹象。

sentences.en: So does everything that happened today pretty much mean that soon enough, there's going to be some sort of problem in the economy, some sort of recession?
sentences.zh: 那么今天发生的一切是否意味着很快经济就会出现某种问题，某种衰退？

sentences.en: Is that kind of what happened today, that we were officially put on notice, that the good times are probably going to come to an end in the near future?
sentences.zh: 今天发生的事情是否意味着我们正式收到了通知，好日子可能在不久的将来就要结束了？

sentences.en: So there are sort of two paths you could think about here.
sentences.zh: 你可以从两个路径来思考这个问题。

sentences.en: One is, now that we've gone from a period where we were raising interest rates to a period where we're cutting interest rates, we've officially crossed over the peak, and now we're
sentences.zh: 一是，既然我们已经从加息时期进入了降息时期，我们已经正式跨过了顶峰，现在我们

sentences.en: on the way down.
sentences.zh: 正在走下坡路。

sentences.en: That's one interpretation, that we're going into a cutting cycle, into a downturn that the Fed has to respond to.
sentences.zh: 这是一种解读，即我们正在进入一个降息周期，进入一个美联储必须应对的低迷期。

sentences.en: There's another possibility, which is what the Fed is hoping is happening here, which is
sentences.zh: 还有另一种可能性，这也是美联储所希望发生的情况，即

sentences.en: that the Fed is just trying to nudge the economy along so that it doesn't have to take those more aggressive moves down the road.
sentences.zh: 美联储只是试图推动经济发展，这样它就不必在未来采取更激进的行动。

sentences.en: And we don't know yet which of those two paths we're on.
sentences.zh: 我们还不知道我们正处于这两条路径中的哪一条。

sentences.en: The Fed's going to be watching those numbers very, very closely to try to figure out whether
sentences.zh: 美联储将非常非常密切地关注这些数据，以试图弄清楚它

sentences.en: it needs to keep cutting or whether it can get by with a cut or two and just keep the economy going.
sentences.zh: 是否需要继续降息，或者它是否可以通过一两次降息来维持经济运行。

sentences.en: When will we know?
sentences.zh: 我们什么时候才能知道？

sentences.en: Economists almost never see a recession coming ahead of time.
sentences.zh: 经济学家几乎从不提前预见衰退。

sentences.en: The best they can do is know that we are in a recession now.
sentences.zh: 他们能做的最好的事情就是知道我们现在正处于衰退之中。

sentences.en: The Fed is trying to prevent us from falling into one.
sentences.zh: 美联储正试图阻止我们陷入衰退。

sentences.en: We won't know if they succeeded until we look up one day and we say we're in a recession.
sentences.zh: 我们只有在某天抬头发现自己身处衰退时，才知道他们是否成功了。

sentences.en: Or we are talking in six months and we say, man, we're not in a recession.
sentences.zh: 或者六个月后我们交谈时说，天哪，我们没有陷入衰退。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that's what we'll know.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们到时候会知道的情况。

sentences.en: On some level, if the Fed succeeds, we may never know.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，如果美联储成功了，我们可能永远不会知道。

sentences.en: We will never know exactly what would have happened in the economy if the Fed had not taken this action today.
sentences.zh: 如果美联储今天没有采取这一行动，经济会发生什么，我们永远无法确切知道。

sentences.en: So if we don't fall into a recession, we'll never be able to play it back through without the cut and say, would we have gone into a recession if it weren't for the Fed?
sentences.zh: 所以如果我们没有陷入衰退，我们将永远无法在没有降息的情况下回放一遍，并说，如果不是美联储，我们会陷入衰退吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Because like you said, the Fed is very subtle.
sentences.zh: 因为就像你说的，美联储非常微妙。

sentences.en: They try to be.
sentences.zh: 他们尽量做到这一点。

sentences.en: Thank you, Ben.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，本。

sentences.en: Thanks so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: Tonight, we have to get to the heart and soul of who we are as Democrats.
sentences.zh: 今晚，我们必须触及我们作为民主党人的核心和灵魂。

sentences.en: Joe Biden told wealthy donors that nothing fundamentally would change if he were president.
sentences.zh: 乔·拜登告诉富有的捐赠者，如果他当选总统，根本上什么都不会改变。

sentences.en: Kamala Harris said she's not trying to restructure society.
sentences.zh: 卡玛拉·哈里斯说她并不想重组社会。

sentences.en: Well, I am.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我想。

sentences.en: From the opening moments of Wednesday night's Democratic debate, the leading candidates on
sentences.zh: 从周三晚间民主党辩论的开场时刻起，舞台上的主要候选人，

sentences.en: stage, former Vice President Joe Biden and Senator Kamala Harris, were repeatedly attacked
sentences.zh: 前副总统乔·拜登和参议员卡玛拉·哈里斯，就一再受到对手的攻击，

sentences.en: by their opponents as guardians of the status quo on issues from health care to immigration.
sentences.zh: 称他们是医疗保健到移民等问题上现状的捍卫者。

sentences.en: What did you mean when you said when a woman works outside the home, it's resulting in, quote, the deterioration of family and that we are avoiding these are quotes.
sentences.zh: 当你引用说“当女性在家庭之外工作时，会导致家庭的恶化”以及“我们正在避免”这些话时，你是什么意思？这些都是引语。

sentences.en: It was the title of the op ed.
sentences.zh: 那是那篇评论文章的标题。

sentences.en: And that just causes concern for me because we know America's women are working.
sentences.zh: 这让我感到担忧，因为我们知道美国的女性正在工作。

sentences.en: Thank you, Senator Gillibrand.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，吉利布兰德参议员。

sentences.en: So, well, he has either— I want to bring Senator Harris into this conversation.
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，他要么——我想把哈里斯参议员带入这场对话。

sentences.en: Either he no longer believes it.
sentences.zh: 要么他不再相信这一点了。

sentences.en: I mean, I just think he needs to— I never believed it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我只是觉得他需要——我从来没相信过。

sentences.en: Thank you, Senator Harris.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，哈里斯参议员。

sentences.en: Please respond.
sentences.zh: 请回答。

sentences.en: Much of the night's focus was on Biden.
sentences.zh: 当晚的焦点大多集中在拜登身上。

sentences.en: In a series of pointed exchanges, Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, former Housing Secretary Julian
sentences.zh: 在一系列尖锐的交锋中，克里斯汀·吉利布兰德参议员、前住房部长朱利安·

sentences.en: Castro, and Senator Cory Booker challenged Biden on his past record and current positions.
sentences.zh: 卡斯特罗和科里·布克参议员就拜登过去的记录和当前的立场向他提出了挑战。

sentences.en: The fact is that there's a lot we've done, but here's the deal.
sentences.zh: 事实是我们已经做了很多事情，但情况是这样的。

sentences.en: The fact is that we're talking about things that occurred a long, long time ago, and now all of a sudden, you know, I—
sentences.zh: 事实是我们现在讨论的是很久很久以前发生的事情，而现在突然间，你知道，我——

sentences.en: Both Biden and Harris defended their records against what they said were unfair and inaccurate attacks.
sentences.zh: 拜登和哈里斯都为自己的记录进行了辩护，称针对他们的攻击是不公平且不准确的。

sentences.en: Everybody's talking about how terrible I am on these issues.
sentences.zh: 每个人都在谈论我在这些问题上有多糟糕。

sentences.en: Barack Obama knew exactly who I was.
sentences.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马非常清楚我是谁。

sentences.en: He had—he had 10 lawyers do a background check on everything about me on civil rights and civil liberties, and he chose me, and he said it was the best decision he made.
sentences.zh: 他让10名律师对我关于民权和公民自由的一切进行了背景调查，最终他选择了我，并说这是他做出的最好决定。

sentences.en: Thank you, Mr. Vice President.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，副总统先生。

sentences.en: I'll take his judgment.
sentences.zh: 我接受他的判断。

sentences.en: Mr. Yang.
sentences.zh: 杨先生。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine—until
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作——直到

sentences.en: this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《地铁》节目中，我和莎拉·凯尼格将讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 请在各大播客平台收听。
